name: Huake Engineenring India pvt. ltd.
india_angle: Huake Engineering India Pvt. Ltd. is a subsidiary established to provide clean room solutions in India.
summary: Huake Engineering India Pvt. Ltd. specializes in the design, construction, and maintenance of clean rooms for various industries, including semiconductors. They offer integrated solutions for clean room planning, engineering construction, and system debugging, along with manufacturing purification equipment. Their services are crucial for maintaining the controlled environments required in semiconductor manufacturing.
